items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He took me down to Barry Ulanov's house. He spoke to him about me... So Barry said, 'I'll get one of the greatest priest's that's ever lived.'

ctx.x: Father Woods was my confessor. Professor Barry Ulanov got a hold of him to give me instructions.
We'll go back further. You came back to the United States from France. Were you going to church then or...
